title: Beatrix and the Signal
author: C. M. Joubert
blurb: Tamsin Joubert, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, runs the long route between worlds that no longer speak. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
